title: Qualification evidence
summary: WebSocket dev1 remains the qualified release: RFC 6455 contract suite under ooRexx 5.3.0 r13196 plus live loopback against independent Python websockets through SocketProvider isolation. dev2 is a source candidate awaiting fresh r13196 + Socket Provider dev16 execution.
invariants: dev1 contract evidence includes the RFC 6455 example handshake accept calculation and masking vector.
dev1 live COTS evidence used an independent Python websockets server.
The dev1 live path exercised WebSocketAccess -> SocketProvider -> RxSock TCP -> independent RFC 6455 peer -> WebSocketMessage.
SocketAddress identity survives the isolation seam as an object.
dev2 adds tests for fragmented message reassembly, interleaved ping/pong, close-frame transmission and unexpected continuation fail-closed behaviour.
No dev2 PASS is claimed until those tests execute under ooRexx 5.3.0 r13196 against Socket Provider dev16.
Independent dev2 qualification/review is requested on Rasen Falcon lane websocket-access as REQ-00000381.

provenance.claim: Records dev2 SOURCE_CANDIDATE status and explicit qualification gates.
